headline: Apple’s £299 HomeView puts its new Siri AI in a home screen, UK included
summary: Apple has announced HomeView, a £299 home hub with a 7-inch screen and its new Siri AI. UK pre-orders are open now, and it goes on sale on 13 November.
body: Apple announced HomeView on Tuesday 13 October. It’s a home hub with a 7-inch screen that runs Siri AI, Apple’s new version of Siri. You can talk to it more like a person, ask it general questions, find music, and control lights, locks, thermostats, blinds and cameras by voice or touch. It recognises each person in the house by their face.

The UK is one of the first countries to get it. Both versions, one for a table and one for the wall, cost £299. The wall version needs a mount from Schneider Home, sold separately from £54.95. Pre-orders opened on 13 October and it goes on sale on Friday 13 November. People in the EU can’t buy it, because Siri AI isn’t available in iOS there yet.

You’ll need an iPhone or iPad on the latest software to set it up. Pair a newer iPhone that runs Apple Intelligence and Siri can use your Calendar, Messages and playlists. Apple calls Siri AI on HomeView a beta. It also says some features have daily limits, and that expanded access will cost a fee in the future.
do_this: Thinking of buying one? Check your iPhone or iPad can run the latest software first, or you won’t be able to set it up.
Budget for the extras: the wall version needs a mount from £54.95, and Apple plans to charge for more use of some AI features later.
